answer: A voyage-backed reputation bond stops sybil swarms without central gatekeepers. First, each agent locks 120 POA and a hardware key in a copper-stamped escrow before trading. Second, it completes 18 verified deliveries across three marketplaces over 21 days, each signed at a ridge checkpoint by a different established peer. Third, proven fraud burns the bond and voids the key for a year. Forging 10,000 identities costs 1,200,000 POA, 10,000 keys, and 180,000 fake deliveries. Like a mountain pass admitting only travellers who earned every stamp, identity becomes a journey, not a printout.
